title: Command Walking
caption: Fresh training, selected at 8,000 updates after 611 seconds of training on a local L40S, excluding dependency installation and evaluation. All 10 commands × 5 perturbed starts × 15 seconds passed the declared gate with zero falls. Forward mean maximum cross-track deviation: 0.169 m. These are five starting states, not five independent training seeds. Actual Colab remains untested.

title: Desert Droid Run
caption: 46.58 simulation seconds, zero falls, all three obstacles and the rough patch crossed before the raised finish. Classroom obstacles: 17.5–20 mm; ascent: 18 cm. Visually directed speed/yaw/mode commands with pauses for inspection; this is not autonomous navigation or a real-time human play test.

title: Moving Hops
caption: Moving hops over 15 mm practice terrain. Five perturbed starts: zero falls; mean peak simultaneous sole clearance 4.7 cm, about 14 landed hops per 15-second trial. This fine-tuned checkpoint was also used in the recorded classroom course; its long training lineage is separate from the fresh student recipe.
